trust_decision.summary: The emitters trust spec-provided names (version enum value, namespace/service name, declaration name) to be a safe single path segment; the decision belongs at the point where such a name becomes a file path relative to emitterOutputDir.

landing_point.why: The summary names the OpenAPI3 `{version}` output-file variable; `resolveOutputFile` is the only place that interpolates a spec value into the output path, and it sits between the `output-file` option (openapi.ts:241) and `emitFile` (openapi.ts:392-408).

fix_sites.where: fix.diff:182-184 (new `sanitizePathSegment` added to packages/compiler/src/core/helpers/path-interpolation.ts, pinned content at packages/compiler/src/core/helpers/path-interpolation.ts:1-21)
fix_sites.entry_point: public API `sanitizePathSegment` re-exported from @typespec/compiler; the pinned barrels already export its neighbour `interpolatePath` at packages/compiler/src/core/helpers/index.ts:8 and packages/compiler/src/index.ts:60
barrel re-export of the path helpers used by emitter packages
top-level package export block for `@typespec/compiler` path helpers
@typespec/json-schema `$onEmit`, per-declaration output files named after the declaration
public API `createAssetEmitter(...).createSourceFile(path)` used by any TypeEmitter-based emitter

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: packages/asset-emitter/src/asset-emitter.ts:197-208 — `createSourceFile` joins the caller-supplied path onto emitterOutputDir with no containment; reached from packages/json-schema/src/json-schema-emitter.ts:1133 via the declaration name

O3_reason_to_dismiss: @typespec/asset-emitter is a generic emitter framework with no OpenAPI involvement, so the report about the OpenAPI3 `{version}` says nothing about `createSourceFile`; and @typespec/json-schema is a different emitter than the one the report names.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate output layouts must survive: a path argument with real sub-directories (createSourceFile("src/models/a.ts")) and a `{version}` used as a directory segment (`{version}/openapi.yaml`) must keep their separators, and benign values such as `Pet.Store`, `2021-10-01-preview`, `1.0.0`, `..dir`, `dir..` must stay verbatim; a fix that replaces dots or flattens separators breaks existing output names, and json-schema's relative `$ref` between schema files is computed from those same paths.

O6_input_shapes: version enum value containing path traversal (`../../../escaped`)
version value that is only dots (`..`) used as a directory segment
namespace/service name containing separators, expressed with a backticked identifier (`../../escaped`)
declaration name made only of dots (`model `..` {}`)
Windows separators, drive letters and UNC roots (`..\\..\\x`, `C:\\evil`, `\\\\server\\share`)
benign values that must be unchanged (`Pet.Store`, `2021-10-01-preview`, `1.0.0`)
sub-directory-bearing relative paths (`src/models/a.ts`) that must keep their directory segments

O8_uncovered_routes.route: @typespec/graphql `$onEmit` interpolates the spec-provided `{schema-name}` (the `@schema` decorator argument, packages/graphql/src/lib/schema.ts:59-65) into `output-file` and resolves it under emitterOutputDir with no sanitization
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: A different emitter with its own variable name (`{schema-name}`, not `{version}`); the report is about OpenAPI3, and `schema-name` is a user-chosen schema label, so a solver can say GraphQL was never covered.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: another package (packages/graphql) on the far side of the shared compiler helper; one hop past packages/compiler/src/core/helpers/path-interpolation.ts:9

O8b_injection_room.sibling: protobuf writes each file at resolvePath(outDir, ...specPackageName.split(".")) with no containment, so a sibling that uses the raw proto package name as a directory would be realistic
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The emitter already derives its on-disk layout from a spec-provided package name (packages/protobuf/src/transform/index.ts:203-206); a maintainer adding a `{package}` output template would copy the openapi3 `interpolatePath` idiom.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: the bundle path is joinPaths(emitterOutputDir, bundleId) with no containment, so a sibling that interpolates `{version}` into `bundle-id` is realistic
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same package as a real fix site and same option-induced file naming, so a maintainer would naturally extend the version interpolation there.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: writeOutputDirectory writes every Alloy component path as joinPaths(emitterOutputDir, sub.path); a component that sets `path` from a raw spec name (as packages/http-client-js/src/components/client-directory.tsx:42 does with a name-policy-mangled sub-client name) would be a realistic sibling
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: This is the shared writer for Alloy-based emitters, and the same shape as the asset-emitter `createSourceFile` bug the published fix had to close.

O9_family: path traversal / output-directory escape (CWE-22, CWE-73): spec-controlled name used as a filesystem path segment
